min_shot_rule: Colden 2026-10-02 (Q7): minimum shot 1 s (edit-shorts' own floor; AMIRA reels use 3 s, CWC_PodCut 2 s)
quiet_tail_rule: 2026-10-02 (s01: Nick ran straight on - '...art to me. Now, it's...'): when the next word starts inside the end hold, the PICTURE holds 6 frames past the payoff with A1 muted (-60 dB) - no dead stop, no stray word
end_hold_rule: the short ends cold on the payoff: up to 0.4 s of picture after the last word, through silence only (AMIRA reels' visual hold; edit-shorts breathed up to 0.65 s)
hide_order: Colden 2026-10-02 (Q7): layout change > b-roll > punch-in; a punch-in only on a camera file of 2160 px or more (the 1080p webcams are already cropped hard in vertical). Never a jump cut.

captions.width_rule: 2026-10-02 s01: 21-char lines with wide letters wrapped in Text+ (LayoutWidth 0.9). A line must measure <= 1760 in MOON GET! Heavy at size 100 with his tracking (1.127): widest seen fitting 1733, narrowest wrapping 1823
captions.rule: edit-shorts: phrase pop <= 4 words / <= 22 chars (one line at Colden's Size 0.06), steady under b-roll; a listener's 1-2 word backchannel over the talker is not captioned; a censored word is shown masked (S***)

tag.rule: guests only (Colden 2026-10-01); white card, YouTube avatar + handle, top-left of the guest's panel, ~3 s, under the B-roll track

broll.rule: ALWAYS full frame 1080x1920 cover crop (Colden 2026-09-23); edges on a cut or >= 15 frames clear (2026-09-13); never in the hook window, never over the last 1.5 s, never over the name tag; eased moves, never the same move twice in a row

beep.rule: Colden 2026-10-02: the Power Bin beep; let the first 3 frames of the word through, beep + duck, end 3 frames before its end; a short word gets one 3-frame beep centred on it

audio.rule: Colden 2026-10-02 (Q8): a vertical template whose A1 carries his Fairlight strip; every short is a duplicate of it; ISO audio present and every clip disabled (one line can be flipped on); no music; master -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP

layout.cast_order_rule: hosts in the show file's order, then guests
layout.stack2: Colden top, the other bottom, whoever speaks (edit-shorts)
layout.stack3: the speaker centred, the others top / bottom in cast order (edit-shorts)
